timing: TEMPO2 with released fixed .par model, DE440, TT(BIPM2021), release clock overrides. Use unwhitened residuals. Compare inverse-variance-weighted RMS about the weighted mean.
epochs: Group on the integer part of barycentric MJD. Use inverse-variance means for measurements, times and Fourier columns. Evaluate signal and white-noise variances at native TOAs before grouping.
filter: Three history-to-detector coefficients of the existing CSPP v0.25 five-node control with theta=21, divided by their signed sum. Route the most recent available epochs at or before t-360 and t-180 days, each at most 60 days older than its anchor, and the current epoch to histories H1, H2 and H3. Both arms use the same retained epochs.
statistic: For each pulsar, simultaneously regress on constant, linear, quadratic and the first five common sine/cosine modes using the unfiltered epoch weights in both arms. Start at the array's earliest native TOA and use its full span T. For each pair sum the products of matching harmonic coefficients divided by two. Estimate correlated power by a zero-intercept fit of these pair values to the Hellings-Downs off-diagonal coefficients. No pulsar autocorrelations.
null: Independent, same-spectrum Gaussian red residuals per pulsar with 0.60 us ensemble RMS and independent Gaussian measurement noise at the published TOA errors. No inter-pulsar correlations.
injection: Add independent Gaussian Fourier coefficients with Hellings-Downs correlations, diagonal 1, and 0.30 us ensemble RMS. The spectrum is proportional to k^(-13/3), normalised over the five modes.
decision: Calibrate a separate upper-tail order-statistic threshold for each arm at nominal 5%. Report independent null false alarms with Wilson 95% intervals, paired detection fractions and paired difference. For the measured-residual replay, evaluate score(r+s)-score(r), divide its ensemble mean by the injected power and report mean pair pattern. The filter qualifies for this benchmark only if both null intervals contain 5%, the lower paired 95% detection-difference bound exceeds zero, the recovered power fraction is between 0.90 and 1.10 and the cosine of the recovered and predicted angular patterns is at least 0.95.
scope: Residual-domain conditional injection at fixed timing solution, finite frequency band, eight selected sky directions. The operating false-alarm rate concerns the specified synthetic null. No sky-background or causal-set parameter inference.
